When node bandwidth recovery settings are defined.

Fixes #95561

body:
The related PR fixes the issue. I manually tested according to the above-mentioned great instructions (thanks @romain-chanu !) on cloud to take a snapshot. I only loaded 14% of the nyc_taxis dataset, because it was uploading too slow. This resulted to a 2.5gb index. I re-indexed it to many other copies of the same index. So that the snapshot has a substantial size.

On a cloud instance on a recent ES version, I noticed:

```
[instance-0000000001] using rate limit [75.6mb] with [default=40mb, read=160.9mb, write=75.6mb, max=18.4gb]
[instance-0000000000] using rate limit [222.5mb] with [default=40mb, read=375.5mb, write=222.5mb, max=54.3gb]
...
May 9, 2023 @ 15:23:57.047 [instance-0000000000] snapshot [found-snapshots:cloud-snapshot-2023.05.09-1qdilynhqackgpijxzmvxw/6HnHIWTTScGDfnC9PDMyAQ] started
May 9, 2023 @ 15:30:21.533 [instance-0000000000] snapshot [found-snapshots:cloud-snapshot-2023.05.09-1qdilynhqackgpijxzmvxw/6HnHIWTTScGDfnC9PDMyAQ] completed with state [SUCCESS]
```

This was for a total of 5 indexes. The peak instance 0 outgoing container network bandwidth: 40mb/s

On a cloud instance with my PR, I noticed:

```
[instance-0000000001] using rate limit [75.6mb] with [default=40mb, read=160.9mb, write=75.6mb, max=18.4gb]
[instance-0000000000] using rate limit [222.5mb] with [default=40mb, read=375.5mb, write=222.5mb, max=54.3gb]
...
May 9, 2023 @ 17:00:00.029 [instance-0000000000] snapshot [found-snapshots:cloud-snapshot-2023.05.09-1rvkvw-pseoeyln1tahcka/lTGRjgd5SqysyqY7lK9MYw] started
May 9, 2023 @ 17:02:12.563 [instance-0000000000] snapshot [found-snapshots:cloud-snapshot-2023.05.09-1rvkvw-pseoeyln1tahcka/lTGRjgd5SqysyqY7lK9MYw] completed with state [SUCCESS]
```

This was for a total of 20 indexes. The peak instance 0 outgoing container network bandwidth: 225mb/s
